parameters.content:
## Configure Settings 
- Post ID - from LinkedIn
- Trigger Word - what people comment on the post
- Lead Magnet URL - what we're giving away

## Get all the comments from the post 
- Get all comments
- Filter the ones that contains the trigger word

## Check if we are connected
- check the connection level
- if it's 1 we can send the DM directly
- if not we first ask them to connect

## Filter the ones where already have sent messages
In both cases, check Nocodb to see if we already have sent a DM or a connection request to avoid double-sends.

## Ask them to connect
- Answer to their comment by asking them to connect.
## Merge both branches and filter if there is more pages
## Initialize the cursor to avoid errors

## Send the DMs
- Create a loop so we can log and send them one by one. 
- Add a wait time of a few minutes to avoid problems with linkedin ates and make it random to make it seems more natural. 
- Send the DM including the first name and the link to the lead magnet. 
- Comment a comment with a variable message to make it seem more natural. 
- Log everything into Nocodb.
